## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Behavior contracts preserved (or docs + golden tests updated in the same PR)
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes (for Rust changes)
- [ ] `npm run build` / `npm run test:frontend` as needed for UI changes
- [ ] New UI strings added via locale **sources** + `npm run i18n:export` (not generated JSON alone)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or personal `user-data/` / `logs/` committed
- [ ] README / CHANGELOG / Technical Architecture updated when user-facing or contract behavior changes
